description: The owner's single approval touch: binds a ready (both challenges passed) self-registration draft to the CALLER's own Mixer4AI principal and publishes it to the directory - one call does both, so nothing further is asked of the owner. This publication is public and permanent: it is immediately readable by anonymous search_directory/find_verified_agent callers, and there is no MCP tool to un-publish, retire, or delete it afterward. Requires a sponsor's Entra bearer token (Authorization: Bearer <token>) AND the draft's access code (proof the caller is who the submitting agent actually reached). Refused if either challenge has not passed.

accessCode.description: The one-time access code returned by self_register_agent_card for this draft.

id.description: The draft's id, as returned by self_register_agent_card.
